hypothesis.phrase: a hypothesis is a statement that may or may not be true

data-handling cycle.phrase: every piece of data handling follows the same cycle

leading question.phrase: a leading question pushes you towards one answer

response boxes.phrase: a good question is answerable by yes/no, a number, or a choice

open-ended.phrase: open-ended — the answers cannot be counted

region.phrase: milk only = the milk circle’s total minus the overlap

pie chart.phrase: draw the circle and a radius at 12 o’clock

sector.phrase: sweep the first sector, strawberry, 144° clockwise

stem.phrase: the stems are the tens digit

leaf.phrase: land each leaf on its stem, in order along the row

key.phrase: the key tells you what one leaf means

back-to-back.phrase: here are 31 coin weights, already sorted onto a diagram

range.phrase: the range is the biggest weight minus the smallest

mode.phrase: the mode is the value that appears most often

median.phrase: the median is the middle value, the 16th of 31

scatter graph.phrase: tim and june recorded minutes spent on different homeworks

line of best fit.phrase: draw a line of best fit through the middle of the cloud of points

correlation.phrase: as tim’s time goes up, june’s does too

negative correlation.phrase: negative correlation would be the reverse

outlier.phrase: every point here follows the trend, so there is no outlier

estimate.phrase: read up to the line, then across
